title: Final practical assessment: requirements, variant and criteria first
goal: Prepare an independent applied project with known criteria while retaining earlier results.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 7; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: The final work begins before the first edit. Without naming records and expected minutes beforehand, a good-looking table can be mistaken for a correct result. Use your saved training service to define a checkable task: what must persist, what will intentionally change and where the original is kept.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: Use only your synthetic service. Main 440/225/215 and new independent 400/420 are different sets and evidence; do not force them to agree. Preserve the original, DT/CF, attempts and previous work; restore only into a new empty target. Nexus stores a note and independent A/Pprogress; it neither executes external 1C nor awards instructor grades.

sections.title: Requirements describe outcomes
paragraphs: Start the final work from operator tasks: create a request, find open work, obtain a total and restore a copy. Screen lists do not replace requirements. Specify input, action, expectation and evidence for each scenario. Variant parameters are separate so the work is not merely replaying a solved example.

Open this direction in Nexus and choose Open final assessment from its curriculum. There are three theory variants, four practical tasks and one of three projects. Read your variant and criteria first. Reading 32 topics does not replace the project; completion from the other direction does not transfer.

sections.title: How to carry out the worked example
paragraphs: Follow the route in your prepared own copy. This is the worked example; the new task below uses different data. Compare each expectation with your actual reread.
Step 1. Read three variants/four practical tasks/three projects. Record your chosen variant/project IDs and criteria. Expected: Variant and scope selected.
Step 2. Prepare a separate copy or new independent-variant base. Retain accepted source work. Expected: Work has its own name / path / provenance.
Step 3. Record the 12 durations, customer assignment, future actual keys and expected 440/225/215. Expected: Independent expectations prepared.
Step 4. Define input / expectation / evidence for read / write / search / filter / refusal / recovery. Expected: Criteria established before execution.

sections.title: Acceptance includes prohibitions
paragraphs: Positive cases show usefulness; negative cases show boundaries. Include empty customer, invalid duration and attempted restore over existing work. Verify both rejection and unchanged state. A successful ordinary input after failure proves usability rather than mere action blocking.

Use 12 durations:30, 45, 15, 0, 60, 20, 25, 35, 40, 50, 55, 65, totaling 440. Assign odd positions to one customer and even positions to another:225/215. A third equal-named customer with a different reference and no requests tests identity. All records are synthetic.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: The report total matches the expectation. Is one total sufficient for acceptance?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. Missing and extra records can offset their minutes. Compare actual numbers, references, fields and groups, then check refusals and restoration. Understanding and technical correctness are assessed separately.

sections.title: Keep data separate from implementation
paragraphs: Prepare 12 synthetic requests across customers, statuses and duration boundaries. Calculate control totals manually before running reports. A teaching template may seed a new copy, but record provenance and your own changes. Never overwrite previously accepted work for a final variant.

Separate the required core from your extension. Core: cards, references, write/search, customer filtering, correct units and recovery. An optional description or custom form is a separately copied extension with its own checks. Do not claim an absent period filter exists.

paragraphs: References, refusals, recovery and independent work remain unverified.
Demonstrate actual records, independent checks and recovery separately.

sections.title: Publish criteria before work
paragraphs: Assess data correctness separately from usability and explanation. Source preservation during restore is critical: a beautiful report cannot compensate for destroyed work. Local candidate assessment is self-report; instructor review is separate. An A result transfers no P credit and does not certify professional development.

Create a separate result folder and infobase/copy with provenance before input. Calculate controls without using the report being tested. Build requirement → action → expected set → observation → status. Attractive presentation cannot compensate for lost work.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: Choose a final-work variant and one project in this track, recording their actual IDs and criteria. For the new independent continuation preserve A7 with 12 requests and 400 minutes as the original. Before acting, build your own table of its 12 numbers: North 105, South 15, the earlier own customer 185, Alpha 80, Beta 15. The empty equal-named Alpha is a separate reference. Plan a new DT-restored copy and a single A71000003 edit from 15 to 35: expect Beta 35 and 420 overall, with original 400 unchanged. This set is distinct from the main 440/225/215 control.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

sections.title: Actual training-service window
paragraphs: Main 12/440→455 is a prior pinned experiment, not claimed as a fresh execution. The fresh independent DTcopy continues accepted A7: 12/400. After two refused invalid writes, only Beta 15→35 was intentionally changed: copy 12/420, original 12/400. All 12 identities, other fields, A4 note, A5 rows and A6 description persist. A complete manual wizard/learner defense was not checked.
